decisions.reason: As a flagship service that directly extends the firm’s core cloud messaging capabilities, it fits existing knowledge very well and the firm’s in-house R&D makes continued refinement more likely than withdrawal.

This service is closely related to the firm’s document workflow and integration business, and the cited customer use suggests enough market validation for a capable R&D-active firm to continue developing it.

The service builds on the firm’s established multichannel communication expertise, so absorptive capacity is high, though its more niche positioning gives it a somewhat higher risk of later rationalization.

Because it is only a delivery optimization feature in a mature fax-related area, it is the most exposed to bundling or retirement, but its closeness to the core offer still argues for keeping it in the near term.
Threat protection is strongly complementary to the firm’s secure business messaging platform, and with ongoing R&D and enterprise demand for security the firm is likely to retain it.
